title: UsageEvent
description: A single metered usage event ingested by a usage-based billing or metering engine such as Lago, Metronome, Orb, Amberflo, Togai, or m3ter.

event_id.description: Idempotency key uniquely identifying this usage event across re-ingestion attempts.

meter_code.description: Identifier of the meter (event type) this event is being attributed to.

customer_id.description: Customer the usage should be attributed to for billing.

subscription_id.description: Optional subscription this usage event is associated with, when a customer has multiple active subscriptions.

timestamp.description: Time at which the underlying usage occurred.

quantity.description: Numeric quantity associated with this event (calls, tokens, bytes, seconds, units).

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the quantity field.

properties.description: Free-form key/value dimensions used by the metering engine to filter, group, and price events.

source.description: Logical source of the usage event, typically a service, gateway, or product surface.

ingested_at.description: Time at which the metering engine accepted the event.
